snippet.title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (PSP) Full Game
snippet.description:
A full no commentary playthrough of the PSP version of Star Wars The Force Unleashed (2008) being played on the PPSSPP emulator.

Sorry I ended up accidently skipping some minor parts of a few cinematics, nothing important was skipped.

Most if not all graphical bugs and whatnot are probably due to the emulator and not the game itself.

I really enjoyed going through all the battlefront games and recording a playthrough on them, so I decided to do it again with the different versions of TFU. 

Spinning Pony animation made by @itssugarmorning (NSFW) on Twitter. 
Pony Drawing made by @neko_snicker on twitter.
